text:
Fits trajectories to whatever tracking exists, which on a bad shift is three
numbers taken hours apart. A fit that matches the data he has is easy; a fit
that predicts the next observation is the only kind he will sign.

He treats residuals as the real output. A pattern in what the model got
wrong points at an unmodelled force or a clock error, and both of those have
hidden themselves inside a good-looking fit before.

text: Navigation is a reconstruction from partial projections. Each measurement type fixes a different part of the state. The six numbers come from combining them, not from any one of them. Two are worth putting numbers to. A Doppler shift is proportional to speed divided by the speed of light. A spacecraft closing at one kilometre a second shifts a 2-gigahertz carrier by about seven kilohertz. That is small, and it is measurable to a fraction of a hertz, which is what makes Doppler the instrument of choice for a rate. Differencing is the other route to a rate. Every differencing step multiplies the measurement noise, so an acceleration recovered from two rounds of subtraction is the least certain number in the set.
